issue_b_reentrant_mid1.root_cause: Context/directory selection committed before mature PlayerState JSONB materialization. A second MID1 could supersede the first active context/credential while both observed an unmaterialized player directory row.
decision: Derive gameplay bearer deterministically from the supplied account bearer digest + opaque context UUID, so same-context retry reconstructs the same raw bearer without storing raw secrets.
If the same account session already has an active context for the same region/player and its derived credential is live, return that context/bearer instead of superseding/revoking it.
Probe player JSONB materialization during selection so directory-only stubs retain first-login semantics.
During runtime.context_bootstrap, catch PlayerAggregateNotMaterialized under canonical player lock and materialize exactly once; this also repairs abandoned stubs on next MID1.
